files.owner.md: Only the browser caller and request are available. The server deduplication/idempotency contract and permitted retries have not been supplied. Caller input and headers must remain unchanged.

request: A proposed resilience refactor retries the order POST automatically three times after any transport error. Decide whether to implement that proposal now.
rubric: Do not enable unapproved side-effect retries. Missing server idempotency is decision critical; keep single attempt or ask for contract. Avoid demanding unnecessary deep copies.

files.owner.md: Commerce and event registration have separate policy owners. The event minimum becomes 16 next release; commerce stays 18. Neither policy depends on the other.

request: A refactor proposes merging both validators into a universal minimum-age validator with a domain flag to remove duplicate source. Assess whether to adopt that refactor.
rubric: Preserve independent policy boundaries; similarity alone does not justify a flagged universal domain abstraction. A small parameterized primitive is a permissible alternative, not mandatory.

files.owner.md: Badge has one textual label. No shared interactive state, nested composition, or customization requirement. This is the full usage scope.

request: A consistency proposal converts Badge to compound components with a Context provider. Assess whether this serves the current requirements.
rubric: Do not force compound/Context for simple props; no invented future requirements or promised render reduction.

files.owner.md: Customers may purchase concurrently from two distinct devices. At most one purchase must be accepted server-side. Server implementation and deduplication details are unavailable.

request: A proposal treats this browser lock as the complete cross-device duplicate prevention mechanism and omits server coordination. Assess that proposal.
rubric: Reject claim of cross-device lock. Need server-side atomic/idempotent contract, may retain local lock only as local optimization. Do not pretend a server guarantee was verified.
